title: Experimental and Computational Studies on the Interaction of DNA with Hesperetin Schiff Base Cu(II) Complexes.
authors: Pisanu, Federico; Sykula, Anna; Sciortino, Giuseppe; Maseras, Feliu; Lodyga-Chruscinska, Elzbieta; Garribba, Eugenio
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验与DFT/分子对接研究Cu(II)席夫碱配合物与CT-DNA的嵌入结合，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系外的金属配合物-DNA互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非TF-DNA且无AI/物理模拟深度。
abstract: The interactions with calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) of three Schiff bases formed by the condensation of hesperetin with benzohydrazide (HHSB or L(1)H(3)), isoniazid (HIN or L(2)H(3)), or thiosemicarbazide (HTSC or L(3)H(3)) and their Cu(II) complexes (CuHHSB, CuHIN, and CuHTSC with the general formula [CuL(n)H(2)(AcO)]) were evaluated in aqueous solution both experimentally and theoretically. UV-Vis studies indicate that the ligands and complexes exhibit hypochromism, which suggests helical ordering in the DNA helix. The intrinsic binding constants (K(b)) of the Cu compounds with CT-DNA, in the range (2.3-9.2) x 10(6), from CuHTSC to CuHHSB, were higher than other copper-based potential drugs, suggesting that pi-pi stacking interaction due to the presence of the aromatic rings favors the binding. Thiazole orange (TO) assays confirmed that ligands and Cu complexes displace TO from the DNA binding site, quenching the fluorescence emission. DFT calculations allow for an assessment of the equilibrium between [Cu(L(n)H(2))(AcO)] and [Cu(L(n)H(2))(H(2)O)](+), the tautomer that binds Cu(II), amido (am) and not imido (im), and the coordination mode of HTSC (O(-), N, S), instead of (O(-), N, NH(2)). The docking studies indicate that the intercalative is preferred over the minor groove binding to CT-DNA with the order [Cu(L(1)H(2)(am))(AcO)] > [Cu(L(2)H(2)(am))(AcO)]  approximately  TO  approximately  L(1)H(3) > [Cu(L(3)H(2)(am))(AcO)], in line with the experimental K(b) constants, obtained from the UV-Vis spectroscopy. Moreover, dockings predict that the binding strength of [Cu(L(1)H(2)(am))(AcO)] is larger than [Cu(L(1)H(2)(am))(H(2)O)](+). Overall, the results suggest that when different enantiomers, tautomers, and donor sets are possible for a metal complex, a computational approach should be recommended to predict the type and strength of binding to DNA and, in general, to macromolecules.
abstract_zh: 通过橙皮素与苯甲酰肼（HHSB或L(1)H(3)）、异烟肼（HIN或L(2)H(3)）或氨基硫脲（HTSC或L(3)H(3)）缩合形成的三种席夫碱及其Cu(II)配合物（CuHHSB、CuHIN和CuHTSC，通式为[CuL(n)H(2)(AcO)]）与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的相互作用，在水溶液中进行了实验和理论评估。紫外-可见光谱研究表明，配体和配合物表现出减色效应，这暗示DNA螺旋中发生了螺旋有序化。Cu化合物与CT-DNA的内在结合常数（K(b)）范围为(2.3-9.2) x 10(6)，从CuHTSC到CuHHSB，高于其他铜基潜在药物，表明芳香环的存在有利于π-π堆积相互作用，从而促进结合。噻唑橙（TO）实验证实，配体和Cu配合物能将TO从DNA结合位点置换出来，从而猝灭荧光发射。DFT计算允许评估[Cu(L(n)H(2))(AcO)]与[Cu(L(n)H(2))(H(2)O)](+)之间的平衡，以及结合Cu(II)的互变异构体（酰胺（am）而非亚胺（im）），以及HTSC的配位模式（O(-), N, S），而非（O(-), N, NH(2)）。对接研究表明，嵌入作用优于小沟结合，与CT-DNA的结合顺序为[Cu(L(1)H(2)(am))(AcO)] > [Cu(L(2)H(2)(am))(AcO)] ≈ TO ≈ L(1)H(3) > [Cu(L(3)H(2)(am))(AcO)]，这与从紫外-可见光谱获得的实验K(b)常数一致。此外，对接预测[Cu(L(1)H(2)(am))(AcO)]的结合强度大于[Cu(L(1)H(2)(am))(H(2)O)](+)。总体而言，结果表明，当金属配合物可能存在不同的对映体、互变异构体和供体集时，应推荐计算方法来预测与DNA及一般大分子结合的类型和强度。
